title: Item:Soul Gem: Essence of Earth
wikitext:
{{Help improve}}

'''Soul Gem: Essence of Earth''' can be obtained by casting [[Trap the Soul]] spell on any [[Earth Elemental]] and used for [[Adamantine Ritual]]. You must use [[Khyber Dragonshard]]s.

Good places to farm gems include:
* [[The Lord of Eyes]] (infinite spawns)
* [[Taming the Flames]] 
* [[ToEE: Earth Node]] 

==Historical Notes==
{{ History | section=1 }} 
'''Soul Gem: Essence of Earth''' can be obtained by casting [[Trap the Soul]] spell on a CR7 [[Earth Elemental]] and used for [[Adamantine Ritual]]. You must use [[Small Khyber Dragonshard]]s and HD 20 version of [[Trap the Soul]] spell for CR7 Earth Elementals.
'''Note:''' CR8+ Earth Elementals are too high, and will result in a Strong Soul gem (unsuitable for the ritual).

Quests with CR7 Earth Elementals:
* Two in [[Halls of Shan-To-Kor]] (Elite)
* Two in [[Caverns of Shaagh]] (Hard)
* Four in [[The Depths of Despair]] (Elite)
* Four in [[The Depths of Discord]] (Hard)
* Five in [[The Forgotten Caverns]] (Hard)
* Nineteen in [[Taming the Flames]] (Hard)
* You can find an infinite number of Earth Elementals in [[The Lord of Eyes]] (Normal).  Go to the collection room and use Trap the Soul away from the center platform.  Normal gives the correct Soul Gem.
* A large number of them can be farmed from [[Temple of Elemental Evil Part Two]] (Elite) in the Earth node from the Nodeborn Earth Elementals and Nodeborn Muckman. Used 30HD version and still got the correct version
